findings.description: enable_key_rotation is not set, so it defaults to false and the CMK protecting the logs bucket never rotates its key material. Long-lived key material widens the exposure window if the key is ever compromised and fails common key-management baselines.

No policy argument is supplied, so AWS attaches the default key policy that grants the account root full control, letting any IAM principal in the account that holds kms permissions use or administer the key and decrypt log data. An explicit policy scoped to the log writer/reader principals is required for least privilege.
